Name LeSTAR (Lessius Satellite for Teaching and Autonomous Research)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status cancelled
Entity name Lessius University College
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters Belgium
Partners SCK-CEN, QinetiQ Space, Technical University of Berlin, University of Liege, KU Leuven University
Oneliner

Growing of photosynthetic, edible micro-algae under microgravity conditions.
Description

Growing of photosynthetic, edible micro-algae under microgravity conditions. As long duration manned missions are considered in the near future, a lot of experiments on regenerative life support systems, including biological components will be necessary.
